sharinghistory.history.countryInsightInt: This page provides direct access to information on the historical background for each country. The Historical Profiles and Timeline reflect the specific views of the partner concerned.
sharinghistory.history.intro: The *Sharing History* Virtual Museum and Virtual Exhibitions address Arab–Ottoman–European relations in the 19th century from the specific perspectives of all parties.
sharinghistory.home.exhibitionsText: Discover curated virtual exhibitions exploring specific themes, monuments, and objects from the Sharing History collection.
sharinghistory.home.historicalBackground: The Arab, Ottoman and European perspectives on the shared history of the period 1815 – 1918.
sharinghistory.home.historicalProfilesTe: Illustrated country-by-country profiles of the period, each written from the perspective of the partner concerned.
sharinghistory.home.intro: Sharing History — Arab World – Europe presents objects, monuments and archival documents from the period 1815 – 1918, held by partner museums, archives and institutions across the Arab world and Europe. Explore the collection through the Permanent Collection browser or the full-text Database search.
sharinghistory.home.title: Welcome to Sharing History
sharinghistory.identity.title: Sharing History
sharinghistory.partner.introDiscover: Sharing History — Arab World – Europe is a collaborative project bringing together museums, archives, universities, libraries and cultural heritage authorities from the Arab world and Europe. Browse the partners — and their associated partners — grouped by country.
sharinghistory.profile.intro: Each profile presents the period 1815 – 1918 from the perspective of the country concerned, illustrated with items from the database.
sharinghistory.sheet.author: Author
sharinghistory.timeline.intro: Explore historical events of the period 1815 – 1918. Select a country and/or a time period, choose the Permanent Collection timeline or one of the thematic exhibition timelines, then click **Go**.
